checks.description: Empowering and never deficit-framed, Thmanyah tone, modern and confident, not stiff, not hype. Beauty and skill are confidence and self-expression, never correction.
checks.rule: Fail when the copy frames a deficit, flaw, or correction, shames the reader, leans on hype, or reads stiff and academic instead of clear, modern, and confident.

checks.description: Nothing contradicts the positioning and mission: the Arab elite platform, by Arabs for Arabs, to educate, entertain, and inspire, learning that is inspiring not exhausting.
checks.rule: Fail when the copy contradicts the positioning or mission, for example framing learning as a chore or positioning against the by-Arabs-for-Arabs, elite-teacher promise.

checks.description: Reaches for the brand's signature vocabulary where natural, carries no off-brand, deficit, or hype words, and uses modern loanwords only where the domain expects them.
checks.rule: Fail when the copy uses off-brand, deficit, or hype vocabulary, or forces loanwords where a natural Arabic term is expected, or misses the brand register entirely.

checks.description: Instructor mentions use the name-teaches-topic pattern, anchor authority to a concrete proof, name no private clients or brand-line specifics, and name an instructor only when confirmed.
checks.rule: Fail when an instructor claim is vague hype with no concrete proof, names private clients or brand-line specifics, breaks the name-teaches-topic pattern, or names an unconfirmed instructor.

checks.description: Correct taxonomy (classes and playlists), certificate framed as a personal completion certificate and never accredited, value-led price only where the brief provides it, no invented offer, title, or lineup.
checks.rule: Fail when the copy mislabels the product taxonomy, implies the certificate is accredited, shows a price the brief did not provide, or invents an offer, class title, or lineup.

checks.description: Reader address is gendered to the audience (feminine for beauty and style, masculine or plural elsewhere) and the person and number are consistent within the asset.
checks.rule: Fail when the reader address does not match the audience register for the category, or when person or number shifts inconsistently within one asset.

checks.description: No accreditation implication, no roadmap, fundraising, or unannounced plans.
checks.rule: Fail when the copy implies accreditation, or leaks a roadmap, fundraising, or an unannounced plan.

checks.description: The gate returns a binary verdict with a structured fix list on fail.
checks.rule: Result is pass only when every check passes; otherwise fail with one fix item per failing check, each naming the check, the quoted span, and the required change.
